room.hall.title: Stone Hall
room.hall.description: A bare hall of grey stone. A doorway opens east; a passage runs north.
room.dart_room.title: Dart Corridor
room.dart_room.description: A narrow corridor. Small holes line the walls at chest height.
narration.poison.applied: A dart pricks your arm. Cold spreads from the wound.
narration.poison.tick: The poison burns in your veins.
narration.poison.expired: The poison fades from your blood.
room.gate.title: Gatehouse
room.gate.description: A cramped gatehouse. A wooden door fills the north wall.
npc.guard.description: A guard in a leather jerkin.
npc.golem.description: A golem of grey stone. Nothing living runs in it.
item.door.room: A wooden [door] fills the north wall.
narration.burning.applied: Flames catch on the dry wood.
